看电视对眼睛不好。 (Kàn diànshì duì yǎnjing bù hǎo.) - Watching TV is not good for the eyes. (example row in group-work table)
中国人喜欢喝茶。 (Zhōngguó rén xǐhuan hē chá.) - Chinese people love drinking tea.
茶不仅好喝，而且对身体有好处。 (Chá bùjǐn hǎohē, érqiě duì shēntǐ yǒu hǎochu.) - Tea is both delicious and beneficial to our health.

它可以提神醒脑、抵抗衰老、预防疾病，还有减肥的功效。 (Tā kěyǐ tíshén xǐngnǎo, dǐkàng shuāilǎo, yùfáng jíbìng, hái yǒu jiǎnféi de gōngxiào.) - It can help people refresh themselves, defer aging, prevent diseases and even lose weight.

中国茶有很多种，比如，红茶、绿茶、青茶、花茶等。 (Zhōngguó chá yǒu hěn duō zhǒng, bǐrú, hóngchá, lǜchá, qīngchá, huāchá děng.) - There are a variety of Chinese tea, such as black tea, non-fermented green tea, half-fermented green tea and scented tea.
随着季节的不同，人们会选择喝不同的茶。 (Suízhe jìjié de bùtóng, rénmen huì xuǎnzé hē bùtóng de chá.) - People drink different kinds of tea in different seasons.

一般来说，春天的时候喝花茶，夏天的时候喝绿茶，秋天的时候喝青茶，冬天的时候喝红茶。 (Yìbān lái shuō, chūntiān de shíhou hē huāchá, xiàtiān de shíhou hē lǜchá, qiūtiān de shíhou hē qīngchá, dōngtiān de shíhou hē hóngchá.) - Generally speaking, people drink scented tea in spring, non-fermented green tea in summer, half-fermented green tea in autumn, and black tea in winter.

如果你有机会来中国，一定要体验一下中国的茶文化。 (Rúguǒ nǐ yǒu jīhuì lái Zhōngguó, yídìng yào tǐyàn yíxià Zhōngguó de chá wénhuà.) - If you have an opportunity to visit China some day, you should have a taste of the Chinese tea culture.
王方，昨天和你一起唱歌的人是谁？ (Wáng Fāng, zuótiān hé nǐ yìqǐ chàng gē de rén shì shéi?) - Wang Fang, who was the guy with you in the karaoke yesterday?
一个朋友。 (Yí ge péngyou.) - A friend.
什么朋友？ (Shénme péngyou?) - What friend?
是不是男朋友？ (Shì bu shì nánpéngyou?) - Boyfriend?
不是不是，我同学介绍的，昨天第一次见。 (Bú shì bú shì, wǒ tóngxué jièshào de, zuótiān dì yī cì jiàn.) - No. My classmate set me up with him. We met only yesterday.
左边这个看报纸的女孩子是你姐姐吗？ (Zuǒbian zhège kàn bàozhǐ de nǚ háizi shì nǐ jiějie ma?) - Is the girl on the left reading a newspaper your elder sister?
是，右边写字的那个人是我哥哥。 (Shì, yòubian xiě zì de nàge rén shì wǒ gēge.) - Yes. And the guy on the right writing is my elder brother.
你哥哥多大？ (Nǐ gēge duō dà?) - How old is he?
25岁，他比我大三岁。 (Èrshíwǔ suì, tā bǐ wǒ dà sān suì.) - 25. He is three years older than me.
今天的西瓜怎么卖？ (Jīntiān de xīguā zěnme mài?) - What's the price of watermelons today?
三块五一斤。 (Sān kuài wǔ yì jīn.) - Three yuan and a half per 500 grams.
比昨天便宜。 (Bǐ zuótiān piányi.) - It's cheaper than the price yesterday.
是，苹果也比昨天便宜一些。 (Shì, píngguǒ yě bǐ zuótiān piányi yìxiē.) - Yes. The apples are also cheaper than yesterday.
您来点儿吧。 (Nín lái diǎnr ba.) - Why not take some?
前边说话的那个人就是我的汉语老师。 (Qiánbian shuō huà de nàge rén jiù shì wǒ de Hànyǔ lǎoshī.) - The woman speaking in front of us is my Chinese teacher.
你可能不认识她。 (Nǐ kěnéng bú rènshi tā.) - You may not know her.
是新来的汉语老师吗？ (Shì xīn lái de Hànyǔ lǎoshī ma?) - Is she a new-comer?
是去年来的，她姓王，28岁。 (Shì qùnián lái de, tā xìng Wáng, èrshíbā suì.) - She came here last year. Her family name is Wang, 28 years old.
她比我们老师小两岁。 (Tā bǐ wǒmen lǎoshī xiǎo liǎng suì.) - She is two years younger than my teacher.
哥哥比姐姐高。 (Gēge bǐ jiějie gāo.) - Elder brother is taller than elder sister. (A 比 B Adj example)
今天比昨天热。 (Jīntiān bǐ zuótiān rè.) - Today is hotter than yesterday. (A 比 B Adj example)
今天的西瓜比昨天便宜。 (Jīntiān de xīguā bǐ zuótiān piányi.) - Today's watermelon is cheaper than yesterday's. (A 比 B Adj example)
哥哥没有姐姐高。 (Gēge méiyǒu jiějie gāo.) - Elder brother is not as tall as elder sister. (A 没有 B Adj example)
今天没有昨天热。 (Jīntiān méiyǒu zuótiān rè.) - Today is not as hot as yesterday. (A 没有 B Adj example)
西瓜没有苹果便宜。 (Xīguā méiyǒu píngguǒ piányi.) - Watermelon is not as cheap as apple. (A 没有 B Adj example)
西瓜比苹果贵两块钱。 (Xīguā bǐ píngguǒ guì liǎng kuài qián.) - Watermelon is two yuan more expensive than apple. (specific difference)
我的学习比他好一点儿。 (Wǒ de xuéxí bǐ tā hǎo yìdiǎnr.) - My study is a little better than his. (slight difference)
今天比昨天热得多。 (Jīntiān bǐ zuótiān rè de duō.) - Today is much hotter than yesterday. (significant difference)
她比我们老师小两岁。 (Tā bǐ wǒmen lǎoshī xiǎo liǎng suì.) - She is two years younger than our teacher. (specific difference)
他可能早就知道这件事情了。 (Tā kěnéng zǎo jiù zhīdào zhè jiàn shìqing le.) - He may have known about this matter long ago. (可能 before the verb)
可能我明天不来上课了。 (Kěnéng wǒ míngtiān bù lái shàng kè le.) - Maybe I won't come to class tomorrow. (可能 before the subject)
你可能不认识她。 (Nǐ kěnéng bú rènshi tā.) - You may not know her. (可能 before the verb)
昨天和王方一起唱歌的人是谁？ (Zuótiān hé Wáng Fāng yìqǐ chàng gē de rén shì shéi?) - Who was the person who sang with Wang Fang yesterday? (exercise question)
左边看报纸的女孩子是谁？ (Zuǒbian kàn bàozhǐ de nǚ háizi shì shéi?) - Who is the girl on the left reading a newspaper? (exercise question)
她的哥哥25岁了，她多大了？ (Tā de gēge èrshíwǔ suì le, tā duō dà le?) - Her elder brother is 25 years old; how old is she? (exercise question)
昨天的西瓜可能卖多少钱？ (Zuótiān de xīguā kěnéng mài duōshao qián?) - How much might the watermelon have cost yesterday? (exercise question)
王老师是新老师吗？ (Wáng lǎoshī shì xīn lǎoshī ma?) - Is Teacher Wang a new teacher? (exercise question)
明天你去不去银行？ (Míngtiān nǐ qù bu qù yínháng?) - Are you going to the bank tomorrow or not? (affirmative-negative question, falling intonation)
这件衣服你喜欢不喜欢？ (Zhè jiàn yīfu nǐ xǐhuan bu xǐhuan?) - Do you like this piece of clothing or not? (affirmative-negative question, falling intonation)
十一点多了，你睡不睡觉？ (Shíyī diǎn duō le, nǐ shuì bu shuì jiào?) - It is past eleven o'clock; are you going to sleep or not? (affirmative-negative question, falling intonation)
西瓜比苹果大。 (Xīguā bǐ píngguǒ dà.) - Watermelon is bigger than apple. (affirmative example for pair work)
苹果没有西瓜大。 (Píngguǒ méiyǒu xīguā dà.) - Apple is not as big as watermelon. (negative example for pair work)
我的眼睛比安妮大。 (Wǒ de yǎnjing bǐ Ānnī dà.) - My eyes are bigger than Annie's. (group-work example)
我的手机比大卫的贵三百块钱。 (Wǒ de shǒujī bǐ Dàwèi de guì sānbǎi kuài qián.) - My mobile phone is 300 yuan more expensive than David's. (group-work example)
你每天早上几点起床？ (Nǐ měi tiān zǎoshang jǐ diǎn qǐ chuáng?) - When do you get up every morning?
六点多。 (Liù diǎn duō.) - A few minutes past six.
你比我早起一个小时。 (Nǐ bǐ wǒ zǎo qǐ yí ge xiǎoshí.) - You get up one hour earlier than I do.
我睡得也早，我每天晚上十点就睡觉。 (Wǒ shuì de yě zǎo, wǒ měi tiān wǎnshang shí diǎn jiù shuì jiào.) - I go to bed early also, at 10 o'clock every night.
早睡早起身体好。 (Zǎo shuì zǎo qǐ shēntǐ hǎo.) - It's healthy to keep early hours.
再来点儿米饭吧，你吃得太少了。 (Zài lái diǎnr mǐfàn ba, nǐ chī de tài shǎo le.) - Have more rice, please. You ate too little.
不少了，今天吃得很好，太谢谢你了。 (Bù shǎo le, jīntiān chī de hěn hǎo, tài xièxie nǐ le.) - Not a little actually. I've enjoyed the meal a lot. Thank you so much.
你做饭做得怎么样？ (Nǐ zuò fàn zuò de zěnmeyàng?) - How well can you cook?
不怎么样，我妻子比我做得好。 (Bù zěnmeyàng, wǒ qīzi bǐ wǒ zuò de hǎo.) - Not very well. My wife is a better cook than I am.
下雪了，今天真冷。 (Xià xuě le, jīntiān zhēn lěng.) - It's snowing. It's really cold today.
有零下10度吧？ (Yǒu líng xià shí dù ba?) - The temperature may be 10 degrees below zero, am I right?
是啊，你穿得太少了，我们进房间吧。 (Shì a, nǐ chuān de tài shǎo le, wǒmen jìn fángjiān ba.) - Yes. You wear too little. Let's go inside the house, OK?
好吧。 (Hǎo ba.) - OK.
你在忙什么呢？ (Nǐ zài máng shénme ne?) - What are you busy with?

我弟弟让我帮他找个房子，现在他家离公司有点儿远。 (Wǒ dìdi ràng wǒ bāng tā zhǎo ge fángzi, xiànzài tā jiā lí gōngsī yǒudiǎnr yuǎn.) - My younger brother asked me to find an apartment for him. He now lives far from the company.
住得远真的很累！ (Zhù de yuǎn zhēn de hěn lèi!) - It's really exhausting to live far.
是啊，他也希望能住得近一点儿。 (Shì a, tā yě xīwàng néng zhù de jìn yìdiǎnr.) - It's true. He also wants to live nearer.
他说得很好。 (Tā shuō de hěn hǎo.) - He speaks very well.
我起得很早。 (Wǒ qǐ de hěn zǎo.) - I get up very early.
我睡得也早。 (Wǒ shuì de yě zǎo.) - I go to bed early also.
他说汉语说得很好。 (Tā shuō Hànyǔ shuō de hěn hǎo.) - He speaks Chinese very well. (verb reduplicated with object)
我写汉字写得很好。 (Wǒ xiě Hànzì xiě de hěn hǎo.) - I write Chinese characters very well. (verb reduplicated with object)
姐姐唱歌唱得不错。 (Jiějie chàng gē chàng de búcuò.) - Elder sister sings quite well. (verb reduplicated with object)
他说得不好。 (Tā shuō de bù hǎo.) - He doesn't speak well. (negative form)
我起得不早。 (Wǒ qǐ de bù zǎo.) - I don't get up early. (negative form)
我住得不远。 (Wǒ zhù de bù yuǎn.) - I don't live far. (negative form)
他说汉语说得不好。 (Tā shuō Hànyǔ shuō de bù hǎo.) - He doesn't speak Chinese well. (negative form with object)
我写汉字写得不好。 (Wǒ xiě Hànzì xiě de bù hǎo.) - I don't write Chinese characters well. (negative form with object)
姐姐唱歌唱得不太好。 (Jiějie chàng gē chàng de bú tài hǎo.) - Elder sister doesn't sing very well. (negative form with object)
他说得好不好？ (Tā shuō de hǎo bu hǎo?) - Does he speak well? (interrogative form)
姐姐起得早不早？ (Jiějie qǐ de zǎo bu zǎo?) - Does elder sister get up early? (interrogative form)
你住得远不远？ (Nǐ zhù de yuǎn bu yuǎn?) - Do you live far? (interrogative form)
他比我学得好。 (Tā bǐ wǒ xué de hǎo.) - He studies better than I do. (A 比 B V得Adj)
姐姐比我跑得快。 (Jiějie bǐ wǒ pǎo de kuài.) - Elder sister runs faster than I do. (A 比 B V得Adj)
我妻子比我做得好。 (Wǒ qīzi bǐ wǒ zuò de hǎo.) - My wife cooks better than I do. (A 比 B V得Adj)
他学得比我好。 (Tā xué de bǐ wǒ hǎo.) - He studies better than I do. (A V得 比 B Adj)
姐姐跑得比我快。 (Jiějie pǎo de bǐ wǒ kuài.) - Elder sister runs faster than I do. (A V得 比 B Adj)
我妻子做得比我好。 (Wǒ qīzi zuò de bǐ wǒ hǎo.) - My wife cooks better than I do. (A V得 比 B Adj)
她为什么每天晚上十点就睡觉？ (Tā wèi shénme měi tiān wǎnshang shí diǎn jiù shuì jiào?) - Why does she go to bed at ten o'clock every night? (exercise question)
他们家谁做饭做得好？ (Tāmen jiā shéi zuò fàn zuò de hǎo?) - Who in their family cooks well? (exercise question)
今天天气怎么样？ (Jīntiān tiānqì zěnmeyàng?) - How is the weather today? (exercise question)
她这两天在忙什么呢？ (Tā zhè liǎng tiān zài máng shénme ne?) - What has she been busy with these two days? (exercise question)
她弟弟为什么要找新的房子？ (Tā dìdi wèi shénme yào zhǎo xīn de fángzi?) - Why does her younger brother want to find a new apartment? (exercise question)
你喜欢吃米饭还是吃面条？ (Nǐ xǐhuan chī mǐfàn háishi chī miàntiáo?) - Do you like to eat rice or noodles? (alternative question, rising then falling intonation)
你想今天去还是明天去？ (Nǐ xiǎng jīntiān qù háishi míngtiān qù?) - Do you want to go today or tomorrow? (alternative question, rising then falling intonation)
你去学校是开车还是坐车？ (Nǐ qù xuéxiào shì kāi chē háishi zuò chē?) - Do you go to school by driving or by taking a bus/car? (alternative question, rising then falling intonation)
他跑得很快。 (Tā pǎo de hěn kuài.) - He runs very fast. (pair-work example)
我跑得不快。 (Wǒ pǎo de bú kuài.) - I don't run fast. (pair-work example)
我比大卫跑得快。 (Wǒ bǐ Dàwèi pǎo de kuài.) - I run faster than David. (relay-game example, Wang Fang)
我唱得比安妮好。 (Wǒ chàng de bǐ Ānnī hǎo.) - I sing better than Annie. (relay-game example, David)
门开着呢，请进。 (Mén kāi zhe ne, qǐng jìn.) - The door is open. Come on in.
请问，张先生在吗？ (Qǐngwèn, Zhāng xiānsheng zài ma?) - Excuse me, is Mr. Zhang in?
他出去了。 (Tā chūqu le.) - He's gone out.
你下午再来吧。 (Nǐ xiàwǔ zài lái ba.) - Please come in the afternoon.
好的，谢谢！ (Hǎo de, xièxie!) - OK. Thank you!
那个正在说话的女孩儿是谁？ (Nàge zhèngzài shuōhuà de nǚháir shì shéi?) - Who is the girl speaking?

我知道她的名字，她姓杨，叫杨笑笑，她姐姐是我同学。 (Wǒ zhīdào tā de míngzi, tā xìng Yáng, jiào Yáng Xiàoxiao, tā jiějie shì wǒ tóngxué.) - I know her name. Her name is Yang Xiaoxiao. Yang is her family name. Her elder sister is my classmate.
那个手里拿着铅笔的呢？ (Nàge shǒu li názhe qiānbǐ de ne?) - What about the girl with a pencil in her hand?
我不认识。 (Wǒ bú rènshi.) - That one I don't know.
